Paper Trade Crypto Futures — Practice Long & Short With Zero Risk

Tools · 4 min read · Updated August 2026

Paper trading is the fastest, safest way to learn crypto futures: you open a real position at the live market price and watch your profit and loss move exactly like a real exchange — except nothing is on the line. MarginPad's Paper Trade tool does this in your browser, free, with no account and no deposit.

How it works

Pick a coin, choose Long or Short, type how much you want to put in and your leverage, then hit open. The trade is created at the current market price and starts tracking immediately:

  • Live P&L and ROE — your unrealized profit updates tick by tick as price moves.
  • Liquidation price — see exactly where a real position would be wiped, so you feel what your leverage really means.
  • Optional stop-loss & take-profit — set them and the position closes itself when hit, just like the real thing.
  • Buy/Sell signals — toggle a Supertrend overlay on the chart to practice reading entries and exits.

Every position lands in My Trades, where you can watch it live, close it, or reopen it. Each trade is a shareable ticket — tap the share icon for a clean P&L card, or copy the link and image to post your result.

Why paper trade first?

Leverage is unforgiving. At 100x, a 1% move against you is a full liquidation; at 1000x it takes a flicker. Paper trading lets you feel that before risking a cent — you learn how leverage, liquidation and position size interact without paying tuition to the market.

Turn practice into a plan

Once a setup feels right on paper, size it properly. Decide your stop, then let it set your position size so a loss is a fixed small slice of your account. Our position size calculator and liquidation calculator turn a paper idea into a real, risk-managed trade.
